---
name: Device report
about: Tell us how FireLab works on your Fire TV (or send a profile as a pull request)
labels: device
---

**Model code and name:** (Settings > My Fire TV > About, or `firelab info`; e.g. AFTKA, Fire TV Stick 4K Max)
**Fire OS version:**

**What works / what doesn't:** (`npm run device:check -- --device <ip>` prints a "tested on" row you can paste)

**Profile:** if you can, record one with `firelab profile -d <ip>` and open a pull
request with `profiles/<MODEL>.json` (see `profiles/README.md` in the repository).
